case_seeds.label: menu_dispatch
case_seeds.observation: A documented menu operation may be missing or attached to the wrong command.

case_seeds.label: input_buffer_misuse
case_seeds.observation: Mixing token, character, and full-line reads can consume pending whitespace as data.

case_seeds.label: invalid_program_state
case_seeds.observation: A menu action may run before the required vector or matrix has been read.

case_seeds.label: wrong_identifier_or_argument
case_seeds.observation: A valid but semantically unrelated variable may be used in an assignment or function call.

case_seeds.label: toolchain_or_portability_issue
case_seeds.observation: C and C++ headers, compilers, and non-standard console APIs may be mixed.

case_seeds.label: vector_shift_and_boundary
case_seeds.observation: Insertion and deletion require coordinated bounds, indices, and logical-size updates.

case_seeds.label: file_cursor_state
case_seeds.observation: Repeated reads can assume data remains after the input source has been exhausted.
case_seeds.decision: Over-reading or under-reading a counted file sequence is a loop-boundary error; selecting the wrong stream is a wrong-identifier-or-argument error. A separate label would duplicate established misconceptions.

case_seeds.label: declaration_or_identifier_typo
case_seeds.observation: Misspelled declarations and unknown identifiers are common compile-time failures.

case_seeds.label: curriculum_coverage
case_seeds.observation: The introductory sequence covers numeric expressions, conditions, loops, digit processing, arrays, strings, functions, and basic file handling, including sentinel-driven repetition and older portability patterns.
